newsitem.title: USA: Celtic Investment enters merger agreement.
newsitem.headline: Celtic Investment enters merger agreement.

text.p: Celtic Investment Inc said Thursday it executed a definitive agreement and plan of merger with Salt Lake Mortgage Corp.
In the stock-for-stock transaction, Celtic will exchange 1.1 million shares in exchange for all of Salt Lake Mortgage's shares.
Salt Lake Mortgage, a Salt Lake City-based mortgage loan origination and real estate marketing company, generated about $1.5 million in revenues last year.
Celtic said this is one step towards achieving its long-term strategic business plan of becoming a diversified financial services holding company.
